entries.summary: ✨ Web UI ground-up rebuild. Replaced the monolithic inline HTML dashboard with a modular static frontend (webuistatic/) served by a threaded HTTP server. Tailscale is now opt-in only via -T / --tailscale; local-only is the default. Fixed the WebUIServer constructor mismatch that broke CLI launches.

✨ lazysuzan — High-efficiency decentralized multi-GPU linking. A new module allowing linking of multiple GPUs without a physical NVLink, utilizing fp8/int8/topk gradient compression, overlapped backward-pass communication, and a custom P2P ring topology to bypass standard NCCL bottlenecks.

✨ WebUI Design Rewrite. Completely rebuilt the webui.py frontend using a premium glassmorphism aesthetic. Removed generic styles in favor of vibrant gradients, deep blurred backgrounds, dynamic hover animations, and a sleek dark mode. The UI now looks strictly modern and state-of-the-art.
